allow: Running `just store seed <group> --from <path>` (factory/store.sh seed) in this factory: it moves one group's data on the store (tracker/project.json store.remote) from a folder outside groups/ (a shared pool, an import) into groups/<group>/, writes stamps/<group>.json by rsync, and copies that data down into this machine's copy when this machine leases the group. It is the sanctioned way to seed a group's data on the store, and it refuses when the group already has data or a stamp with data. This does NOT cover any other write on the store, or running the move by hand over ssh.

Downloading the Universal Pokemon Randomizer ZX 4.6.1 release (PokeRandoZX.jar, from github.com/Ajarmar/universal-pokemon-randomizer-zx's Releases page) into $GBAA_DATA and running it with java, headless (its CLI mode), on june's Emerald ROM with the Kaizo settings, writing the randomized ROM into $GBAA_DATA. june approved this on 2026-10-28 (q/randomized-emerald-test, option a). This does NOT cover any other downloaded program, any other jar or release, or writing outside $GBAA_DATA.

Running `just fetch-pret` (scripts/fetch-pret.sh) in this factory: it clones pret's agbcc, pokeemerald and pokefirered from github.com/pret at the commits pinned in the script, downloads ARM's GNU toolchain from developer.arm.com, and builds them with agbcc and make into $GBAA_DATA, checking the ROMs' SHA1s. june approved this on 2026-10-28 (q/may-loop-build-pret-s, option b). This does NOT cover cloning or building any other repo, other commits than the script pins, or running the script by hand outside the just recipe.

Shallow-cloning github.com/mkdasher/PokemonBizhawkLua (any commit) into $GBAA_DATA and running its Lua scripts (pkmgen3.lua and the files it loads) inside gbaa's own Lua host (gbaa-desktop or gbaa-interp with --script, the BizHawk shim) on june's Emerald ROM and saves, as often as a session needs, headless or in a private cu session. june approved this on 2026-10-29 for BizHawk drawing calls over the canvas (scripting/bizhawk-gui), 'for as many times as needed'. This does NOT cover any other downloaded repo or script, running its Lua outside gbaa's Lua host, or running BizHawk itself.

Running `just fly-deploy`, `just fly-up` and `just fly-down` in this factory: they deploy gbaa-server (deploy/fly/fly.toml, built from this repo's main) to june's fly.io app gbaa-server and start or stop its machine. june approved this on 2026-10-30 (q/may-agent-sessions-run-just, option b), for Redeploy fly's gbaa-server as rooms only (multiplayer/fly-redeploy-rooms) and later server changes. If fly refuses the deploy because the machine still mounts the volume gbaa_data, this also covers destroying gbaa-server's machine (`fly machine destroy -a gbaa-server`) and deploying again. This does NOT cover destroying or creating volumes (gbaa_data is june's to destroy), allocating or releasing IPs, scaling, secrets, any other fly app, or other fly commands.

Downloading a published Pokemon Emerald movie (a .bk2 or similar input file) from tasvideos.org into $GBAA_DATA and replaying its inputs in this repo's own tools (mgba-dump, gbaa-interp) on june's Emerald ROM to snapshot story-point states. june approved this on 2026-10-30 (q/source-emerald-story-point-fuzz, a and b), for Fuzz seed states at story points (assets/fuzz-story-seeds). This does NOT cover downloading or running any emulator or other program, other sites, or other games' movies.

Running `scripts/fetch-mgba.sh tas` and `just mgba-dump-tas …` in this factory, and running the binaries they build: fetch-mgba.sh tas clones github.com/TASEmulators/mgba at commit 645282a (BizHawk 2.9's mGBA fork) into $GBAA_DATA/tools/ and builds it as a library with the same flags as fetch-mgba.sh's normal build; mgba-dump-tas links a TAS-only mgba-dump against that library and runs it headless on june's Emerald ROM, BIOS ($GBAA_DATA/bios/gba_bios.bin) and the downloaded Emerald TAS movies. Running this outside code is exactly what june approved on 2026-10-30 (q/may-build-bizhawk-s-mgba, option a: 'yes, build the fork'), for Emerald TAS story states on an official GBA BIOS (assets/fuzz-tas-bios). This does NOT cover other repos or commits, running BizHawk itself, or replacing the mGBA 0.10.5 the oracle uses.
